I couldn't cancel today's Brightline vendor call (3:00–3:45pm) because Alex Moreno at Brightline set it up, not you. Instead, I declined it for you. Alex has been notified, along with this note: "Sorry, I need to cancel for today's call. I'll follow up to reschedule."

Declining only takes you off the call; the meeting is still on Brightline's calendar. Jordan Blake at Brightline is also on the invite. If you want the call called off for everyone, Alex would have to cancel it, and I can write to ask. I haven't set up a new time, so I can also email Alex to suggest times if you'd like.
